rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for physical, structural, or general stability.

example.english: The stability of this table is pretty good; even a computer won’t make it wobble.
example.traditional: 呢張枱嘅穩定性唔錯，放部電腦上去都唔會搖。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 ci4 ge3 wan2 ding6 sing3 m4 co3 fong3 bou6 din6 nou5 soeng5 heoi3 dou1 m4 wui6 jiu4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person's emotional or mental steadiness and ability to recover from disturbances.

example.english: Their emotional stability is pretty good; they can still face such great pressure calmly.
example.traditional: 佢嘅情緒穩定性幾好，遇到咁大壓力都仲可以冷靜面對。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 cing4 seoi5 wan2 ding6 sing3 gei2 hou2 jyu6 dou3 gam3 daai6 aat3 lik6 dou1 zung6 ho2 ji5 laang5 zing6 min6 deoi3
